body:
Integrates reviewed scheduling, repertoire, activity, Redis and Study source maps with B27 current main, and maps current analysis-paste preview, command and storage. The branch storage note reflects retired Coverage handling. No runtime behavior changes; the census remains partial at 237 of 289 files.

Validation: component checker, four scoped analysis-paste ownership/discovery controls, 12 retired-Coverage input tests and 49 scheduling boundary/package checks passed using existing task-owned dependencies without builds or Docker. Earlier reviewed per-batch checks and fixture gaps remain recorded in the component README, including two diagnostics, 24 PGN scope, nineteen earlier and ten missing-adapter cases. Native and live behavior were not qualified.

## Summary by Sourcery

Expand the Study ownership census and strengthen validation of newly mapped scheduling, background, Redis, repertoire, control, and analysis-paste components.

New Features:
- Expand the Study ownership census with seven additional source-map scopes covering scheduling review, repertoire snapshots and verification, background activity and metrics, Redis runtime, Study controls, and analysis-paste flows.

Bug Fixes:
- Add semantic checks that ensure scheduling review routes, task registration, command bindings, and registry entries remain connected.

Enhancements:
- Increase tracked ownership coverage from 199 to 237 of 289 Python files and enforce discovery and ownership validation for the new scopes.
- Document unresolved fixture and environment gaps while clarifying that the census does not provide native or runtime qualification.

Documentation:
- Update the component-build README with the expanded ownership selections, validation results, and remaining coverage gaps.

Tests:
- Extend component census integration tests for the new scopes, sibling discovery, and owner-removal failures.
- Add scheduling boundary tests for semantic review dispatch links and missing-source-link rejection.

Chores:
- Record retired Coverage handling in the ownership census metadata and schema.
title: Expand Study ownership census
